evidence.dominant_driver: Concrete cancellation of September Saudi crude cargoes to European refiners after the East-West pipeline shutdown.

absorption.reason: Oil and European equities were already in a supply-shock/risk-off regime before this incremental confirmation.

observations.equities: European and US equity futures lower

evidence.decision_notes: Forecast residual move from 14:06 UTC; do not forecast the original pipeline-closure shock. Learning profile has no ACTIONABLE M2 evidence segment applicable here, so confidence is unchanged.

immediate.rationale: Concrete European supply cancellation adds residual energy/inflation pressure despite partial pricing.

next_session.rationale: Further downside depends on oil continuation versus adaptation/substitution.

15m.rationale: Fresh confirmation can extend risk-off briefly.

4h.rationale: Existing move is extended and substitution headlines can fade the shock.

next_session.rationale: Market may shift to repair duration and replacement supply.

predictions.mechanism: Higher European crude replacement costs and inflation/rates pressure.
predictions.invalidation: Brent/WTI reverse sharply or Saudi replacement cargoes/routes are confirmed.
predictions.counter_case: European refiners replace barrels quickly and oil fades, producing a relief rally.

immediate.rationale: European supply disruption confirmation is a direct regional macro headwind.

next_session.rationale: Residual impact may fade if oil stabilizes.

4h.rationale: Partly priced and index may stabilize after extension.

next_session.rationale: Replacement supply and diplomacy can dominate.

predictions.mechanism: Regional energy-cost shock raises inflation and margin pressure.
predictions.invalidation: Oil falls materially and replacement crude is secured.
predictions.counter_case: Energy shares cushion the index while broader risk sentiment rebounds.

4h.rationale: No local confirmation strong enough for continued directional edge.
